item.title: Senior Tech Lead / Full-Stack Developer for Technical Assessment of an Existing Travel-Tech Platform
item.description:
400-800 EUR | We are a travel-tech startup preparing to launch an advanced accommodation booking platform. The existing product includes a web application, two mobile apps, a substantial TypeScript/React codebase, numerous API endpoints, payment flows, and third-party integrations.
We are looking for an experienced Tech Lead / Full-Stack Developer who can independently assess an existing codebase, identify the most important technical risks, and help us establish a realistic path to launch. We are not looking to rebuild the platform from scratch.
Phase 1 – Initial Technical Assessment - Review the overall architecture and project structure. - Assess the build, deployment, and testing setup. - Identify and prioritize critical technical risks and potential launch blockers. - Review the highest-risk areas of the booking and payment workflows at an initial level. - Deliver a concise written assessment with recommended next steps, estimated effort, and the proposed scope and cost of a deeper audit.
Required Experience: - Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and API integrations. - Proven experience taking over and stabilizing substantial existing codebases. - Experience with payment integrations including webhooks, refunds, failed transactions, and complex marketplace payment flows. - Familiarity with React Native/Expo, automated testing, security best practices, deployment workflows, and AI-assisted development tools is highly desirable.
Candidates should include: 1. Relevant examples of existing platforms they personally took over or stabilized. 2. Their specific responsibilities in those projects. 3. Their current availability for the initial assessment (15–20 hours) and potential follow-on work.
Budget and Engagement: The initial assessment is limited to 15–20 hours, with a budget of $500–800. This is an initial assessment, not a comprehensive audit or production-readiness certification. Any additional work will be scoped and approved separately based on the findings.
We may subsequently engage the selected candidate as Tech Lead and potentially add a second developer depending on results, availability, and budget.

item.title: Experienced Full-Stack Developer Required – Integrated Enterprise Management System
item.description:
1500-3000 CAD | Experienced Full-Stack Developer Required – Integrated Enterprise Management System
I am looking for an experienced freelance developer or small development team to design and develop a professional web-based **enterprise management system** covering learning, training, nonconformance management, continuous improvement and change management.
The modules should work together through common user accounts, permissions, approval workflows, document storage and reporting. The platform must support multiple organizations with separate data and work smoothly on desktop, tablet and mobile browsers.
The scope includes:
- Learning and training management:** Course administration, registration, scheduling, attendance, assessments, certificates, training records, expiry reminders and competency tracking. - Nonconformance report (NCR) management:** Create and categorize NCRs, assign responsible persons, record investigations and root causes, track corrective actions and deadlines, attach evidence, verify effectiveness and approve closure. - Continuous improvement:** Capture improvement opportunities and suggestions, evaluate and prioritize proposals, assign actions, track implementation and record outcomes. - Change management tracker:** Register proposed changes, document reasons, assess impacts and risks, obtain approvals, assign implementation actions and track completion and review. - Administration and reporting:** Organization and user management, configurable forms and workflows, dashboards, notifications, document storage, audit trails and report exports.
The following expectations are essential:
- Complete development: Handle requirements clarification, UI/UX design, frontend, backend, database, testing and deployment. Deliver a fully functioning application ready for operational use. - Agreed scope and milestones: Confirm requirements, dependencies, deliverables, timelines and acceptance criteria before development. Propose a practical phased delivery plan. - Design approval: Provide wireframes or a clickable prototype for approval before full development. - Integrated, maintainable architecture: Use consistent navigation and shared records across modules, with clear links between related NCRs, improvement actions and changes. The system must support future expansion. - Security and traceability: Implement secure authentication, role-based permissions, separation of organizational data, protected documents, audit history and backup/recovery arrangements. - Progress visibility: Provide regular updates, working demonstrations at each milestone and ongoing access to the source-code repository. - Testing and corrections: Test individual modules and complete workflows across modules. Provide a staging environment for acceptance testing and resolve critical and major defects before final acceptance. - Complete handover: Supply source code, database structure, deployment instructions, administrator documentation and all necessary account access. - Post-launch support: Include a defined bug-fix warranty period and specify maintenance arrangements. - Transparent pricing: Identify inclusions, exclusions, third-party services and recurring costs. Additional work must be agreed before it is charged.
Payments will be linked to completed and accepted milestones.
Please include relevant enterprise software projects you have personally delivered, your role in those projects, your recommended technology stack, estimated cost and timeline, team composition and assumptions. Provide a cost breakdown by module and identify the shared platform development costs.
I am looking for someone who understands business workflows, can recommend practical improvements and takes responsibility for delivering a reliable finished product.
